bio: This wine-decked, book-lined eatery sports a trendy colour scheme that reeks of the Flemish flair for interior decorating. The wine-food pairing suggestions are equally inspired. The food in the zeitgeist sports a subtle blend of tradition and exoticism: you may taste a generous saddle of rabbit or a sole sprinkled in Asian flavours. A deep-rooted respect for heritage paired with a streak of daring....
